title: Prediction of potential mechanisms of rhubarb therapy for colorectal cancer based on network pharmacological analysis and molecular docking.
authors: Yang, Fan; Li, Xinghua; Zhang, Yujie; Ren, Yun; Zhang, Jiao; Xiao, Keyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究大黄治疗结直肠癌的靶点与通路，虽含蛋白-小分子对接，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The objective of this study was to investigate the potential targets and mechanism of Rheum palmatum L in the treatment of colorectal cancer based on the network pharmacology and molecular docking, which could provide the theoretical basis for clinical applications. The potential components were screened using TCMSP database and articles. The gene targets of colorectal cancer were screened through the Genecards database and Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man database. Then, the common targets of components and colorectal cancer were used to construct the network diagram of active components and targets in Cytoscape 3.7.0. The protein-protein interaction (PPI) diagram was generated using String database, and the targets were further analyzed by gene ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes. Molecular docking between gene targets and active components was analyzed via AutoDock, and visualized through PyMol. Among this study, main targets might be TP53, EGF, MYC, CASP3, JUN, PTGS2, HSP90AA1, MMP9, ESR1, PPARG. And 10 key elements might associate with them, such as aloe-emodin, beta-sitosterol, gallic acid, eupatin, emodin, physcion, cis-resveratrol, rhein, crysophanol, catechin. The treatment process was found to involve nitrogen metabolism, p53 signaling pathway, and various cancer related pathway, as well as the AGE-RAGE signaling pathway, estrogen signaling pathway, interleukin-17 signaling pathway and thyroid hormone signaling pathway. The molecular docking was verified the combination between key components and their respective target proteins. Network pharmacological analysis demonstrated that R palmatum was could regulated p53, AGE-RAGE, interleukin-17 and related signaling pathway in colorectal cancer, which might provide a scientific basis of mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在基于网络药理学和分子对接技术，探讨大黄（Rheum palmatum L）治疗结直肠癌的潜在靶点及作用机制，为其临床应用提供理论依据。通过TCMSP数据库及文献筛选潜在活性成分，利用Genecards数据库和在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库筛选结直肠癌的基因靶点。随后，将成分与结直肠癌的共同靶点用于在Cytoscape 3.7.0中构建活性成分-靶点网络图。使用String数据库生成蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）图，并通过基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书对靶点进行进一步分析。利用AutoDock分析基因靶点与活性成分之间的分子对接，并通过PyMol进行可视化。本研究中，主要靶点可能为TP53、EGF、MYC、CASP3、JUN、PTGS2、HSP90AA1、MMP9、ESR1、PPARG。与之相关的10个关键成分可能包括芦荟大黄素、β-谷甾醇、没食子酸、泽兰黄素、大黄素、大黄素甲醚、顺式白藜芦醇、大黄酸、 chrysophanol、儿茶素。治疗过程涉及氮代谢、p53信号通路及多种癌症相关通路，以及AGE-RAGE信号通路、雌激素信号通路、白细胞介素-17信号通路和甲状腺激素信号通路。分子对接验证了关键成分与其相应靶蛋白之间的结合。网络药理学分析表明，大黄可通过调节p53、AGE-RAGE、白细胞介素-17及相关信号通路作用于结直肠癌，这可能为其作用机制提供科学依据。
